correctness.rationale: The proof derives matching necessity, exact one/two/three-positive trace counts from sharp PGL2 triple transitivity and PSL2 pair stabilizer size, excludes size four, and proves a nonzero mod-two cocycle by determinant character. Enumerations of all 3-matching traces and independent determinant-character boundary ranks from fresh package paths agree for q=5 and q=7, yielding (beta1,beta2)=(1,786),(1,7904). General H1 nonzero follows mathematically and is not extrapolated from finite runs.

value.rationale: Natural strict subgroup PSL2 of sharply 3-transitive PGL2 changes the full 2-skeleton of a chessboard complex by an arithmetic character. This gives an exact all-odd-prime-power shattering polynomial and a persistent, explicitly witnessed nonzero first cohomology class despite the full chessboard complex being highly connected. Natural exact q=5,7 ranks quantify the resulting topology and are not arbitrary parameter slices.
